[[Lava Pool]] is a type of [[environment effect]] terrain that, for three seconds, [[cripple]]s and inflicts [[burning]] to any non-[[minion]] [[creature]] walking over it.

== Locations ==
* [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
** [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
*** [[Abaddon's Mouth]]
*** [[Hell's Precipice]]
*** [[Perdition Rock]]
*** [[Ring of Fire]]
* [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]
** [[Depths of Tyria]]
*** [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]]
*** [[Cathedral of Flames]]
*** [[Rragar's Menagerie]] (level 1)
*** [[Shards of Orr]] (level 2 and 3)
*** [[Slavers' Exile]] (Duncan and Selvetarm's levels)
* [[Core]]
** [[Burning Isle]] [[Guild hall]] ([[Guild versus Guild]])
** [[Deepway Ruins]] [[arena]] map
** [[The Crag]] arena map

== Notes ==
* [[Melandru's Resilience]] will provide net [[health regeneration]] while walking in Lava.
* Lava Pool does not have an in-game description.
* Not all visual lava pools inflict the Lava Pool environment effect: notably, the lava in [[The Fissure of Woe]] does not inflict conditions on those that walk in it.
